name: team.opay.offline.acquirer.sdk.module.AcquirerActivity
description: OPay Offline Acquirer opens this screen for deposit, cashier, deposit-history, or bank USSD payment links. It reads the order details and displays the matching payment or deposit screen.
disableEffect: The OPay deposit, cashier, history, and bank USSD entry points handled here will not open, preventing those payment flows from completing.
